buildings.name: Prefab Habitat
buildings.effect: +Pop cap (small). Shown in many TOS/TNG colonies.
buildings.description: Prefabricated living domes shipped down from orbit, the first homes of most Federation colonies. Colonists living here join your crew pool over time, for a little power.

buildings.name: Pressure Dome
buildings.effect: Enables surface building on airless/hostile bodies; +Pop cap. Breach risk under bombardment.

buildings.name: Arcology
buildings.effect: +Pop cap (large); uses 1 slot for 4 habitats' worth.

buildings.name: Kelbonite Shelter
buildings.effect: Population immune to scans, transporter raids, Crystalline Entity, thalaron sweeps.
